'''LD-112''' was a police [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that was active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and served at the large [[Space station/Legends|space station]]. It was destroyed by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] after he destroyed [[SD-357/Legends|SD-357]]. LD-112 was destroyed soon after.<ref name="Revival" />
